Ch142 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 142)

Subject: search algorithms | ID: 142001

Essential Lemma

For every harmonic mapping \(f\) on a Banach space \(X\), there exists a smooth structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that establishes \(\mathrm{dist}(f, \mathcal{S}) \leq \varepsilon\) for all \(\varepsilon > 0\).

Proof

Step 1. Consider the contractive operator \(T_{1420011}\) acting on the finite space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the contractive-finite decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1420011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1420011}\).

Step 2. Consider the differentiable operator \(T_{1420012}\) acting on the compact space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the differentiable-compact decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1420012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1420012}\).

Step 3. Consider the linear operator \(T_{1420013}\) acting on the Banach space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the linear-Banach decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1420013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1420013}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via equivalent interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_{1420011} \cdot C_{1420012} \cdot C_{1420013}\).
